title: 隠し宝庫、全部もらう
reward: 天魔の宝庫と鍛造素材

scenes.name: 死ぬ床
scenes.purpose: 攻略知識を小さく確かめて使う

panels.art: Yun descends cellar stairs, ONE sheathed black sword at left hip, bronze key in left hand. Empty stone passage, red tiles on floor. He halts before stepping on them.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Close view of Yun's free RIGHT hand dropping a small pebble onto a red floor tile. ONE pebble, no sword drawn.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Thin poison darts harmlessly strike the pebble from wall slots. Yun stands safely behind threshold, startled eyes and flinch.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Yun follows a narrow line of GRAY tiles around red trap tiles, cautious stepping, fingertips on wall. NO treasure or smith shown yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

scenes.name: 宝庫の主
scenes.purpose: 危険の後に獲得を大きく見せる

panels.art: Yun uses ONE bronze key to turn a lock under a carved black sword emblem. Sheathed sword at hip. Door still closed.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 正派の鍵じゃ、開かない。

panels.art: Large borderless view of doors open onto a golden underground treasury: ingots, medicine jars, blue-black star metal stones, ONE rolled map. Yun small foreground amazed, no trapped person yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Yun gently lifts a blue-black metal shard, startled by its weight. CYAN translucent hologram says exactly: 星鉄　獲得. No other printed words.
panels.speaker: システム

panels.art: Yun hears a cough from behind a different locked iron door. Turns away from treasure, frown; dark door only, do NOT show captive.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

scenes.name: 売られる手
scenes.purpose: 声の主を最後に明かし救出の選択を作る

panels.art: Close of iron door grille. Yun peers through, his large worried face reflected in dark iron. Sword remains sheathed.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Reveal So Rin captive smith: young adult woman 20, black bob, bronze hairclip, teal vest ivory sleeves dark apron. Seated on stone, ONE pair wrist shackles connected by chain. Exhausted but defiant amber eyes, no sexual framing.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

panels.art: Close of So Rin's scraped hands in shackles, ONE hammer confiscated on table OUTSIDE bars, not in her hand.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン
panels.text: 作れなくなれば、捨てられる。

panels.art: Yun curls his fingers around the grille gently, compassionate determined eyes, no bending metal yet. No rescue before next chapter.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

scenes.name: 声へ返事をする
scenes.purpose: 宝を取る喜びから人の救助へ、音を聞き分けて自分で選ぶ

panels.art: Yun at the treasury exit pauses, ONE black sword safely SHEATHED at left hip. Treasure remains behind him. He turns toward a muffled sound from the lower passage. No prisoner visible.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Small close-up free left fingers set ONE ordinary silver ingot, NOT the acquired dark-blue star iron down on a treasury shelf. No duplicate carried ingots. Calm decision, not tossing valuables.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Yun kneels outside a CLOSED wooden cellar door, lowers his voice. He does NOT open it yet; no smith or bound hands visible.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 聞こえる？　助けに来た。

panels.art: Yun listens with his palm on the CLOSED door. A faint knock answers; his tense shoulders ease. No prisoner, chains or new person shown yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
